summary.title: Practical Deep Learning for Coders
summary.one_liner: A free fast.ai course that teaches programmers with some coding experience how to build, train, and deploy deep learning models for vision, NLP, tabular data, and collaborative filtering using PyTorch and fastai.
keywords: how to learn deep learning as a programmer
takeaways: Train state-of-the-art models for image classification, NLP, tabular data, and collaborative filtering.
Turn trained models into web applications and deploy them.
Learn the calculus and linear algebra needed along the way; no university math is required up front.
The course has 9 lessons of about 90 minutes each and is based on a free online book with Jupyter notebooks.
Free resources such as Kaggle Notebooks and Paperspace Gradient are used instead of special hardware.
summary.summary: This is the landing page for fast.ai's free Practical Deep Learning for Coders course, aimed at people with about a year of coding experience, preferably in Python. The course is taught through examples, starting with a working state-of-the-art model and gradually explaining how the underlying tools work. It uses PyTorch, fastai, Hugging Face Transformers, and Gradio, and is supported by a free online book with interactive Jupyter notebooks. The page lists 9 lessons of around 90 minutes each and points to a newer part 2 course for more experienced students.
